description: Simulates how an AI answer engine (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews) would extract a citable passage from a page. Scans paragraphs, list items, table rows, and FAQ answers, scores each for self-containedness (length, no dangling pronouns, presence of numbers/definitions), and returns the single most citable passage plus an explanation of why it would (or would not) be picked over the others.

url.description: Full URL of the page to analyze.

name: simulate_ai_citation
